units.source_text: 回向乃对一切众生，岂不有你在内？”

en.t: The dedication of merit is offered to all living beings, so surely you are included too?

units.source_text: 这信用深宝蓝色纸，系在一枝莽草上。

en.t: The letter was written on deep sapphire-blue paper and tied to a spray of wild grass.

units.source_text: 此虽普通形式，然而笔致风流潇洒，优雅之趣无异昔时。

en.t: Though the form was ordinary, the brushwork was graceful and free, with the same elegant charm as in former days.

units.source_text: 信送到时，源氏正住在二条院。

en.t: When the letter arrived, Genji was staying at the Nijo estate.

units.source_text: 今后对此人情缘已断，便不妨将信给紫夫人看。

en.t: Since his bond with this woman was now severed, he felt no harm in showing the letter to Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 对她说道：“她驳得我好残酷啊！

en.t: He said to her, She has rebuked me very cruelly.

units.source_text: 我冷眼旁观，阅尽世间种种凄凉之相，实在太无聊了！

en.t: I look on coldly and have seen every kind of desolation in the world; it is truly wearisome.

units.source_text: 可与纵谈寻常世事、省识四时情趣、不乏风流逸致、而能作友谊的交际之人，现世只剩有槿斋院与胧月夜二人，然而皆已出家为尼了。

en.t: The only people left in this world with whom I could freely discuss ordinary affairs, appreciate the moods of the seasons, and share refined and friendly companionship were the Asagao Princess and Oborozukiyo, yet both have become nuns.

units.source_text: 槿斋院修持尤勤，屏绝一切世事，专心诵经礼佛。

en.t: The Asagao Princess is especially diligent in religious practice, shutting out all worldly matters and devoting herself to sutra recitation and worship.

units.source_text: 我阅人多矣，其中只有这槿斋院，一方面思虑周谨，一方面温柔可亲，欲求与她相似之人，亦不可得。

en.t: I have known many people, but among them only the Asagao Princess is both thoughtful and careful, yet gentle and approachable; one could never find another like her.

units.source_text: 教养女子，真是一件非常困难之事。

en.t: Raising and educating a girl is truly a very difficult thing.

units.source_text: 女子生来具有之宿命，是穷是达，目不可得而见。

en.t: The destiny a girl is born with, whether hardship or success, cannot be seen with the eye.

units.source_text: 因此父母予以教养，往往不能如意称心。

en.t: For that reason, even when parents give her an education, things often do not turn out as they wish.

units.source_text: 而从小教养以至成人，实在非常吃力。

en.t: To raise and teach her from childhood until adulthood is truly exhausting.

units.source_text: 我命中注定只有一个女儿，不须多费苦心，倒是好的。

en.t: It may be for the best that fate gave me only one daughter, so I need not spend too much anxious effort.

units.source_text: 年轻的时候，不堪寂寞，盼望子女众多，还常常悲叹呢。

en.t: When I was young, unable to bear loneliness, I longed for many children and often lamented over it.

units.source_text: 请你用心抚育幼小的公主。

en.t: Please raise the young princess with great care.

units.source_text: 女御年纪还轻，尚未深解世事，加之身在宫中，职务多忙，凡事不能顾虑周至也。

en.t: The nyogo is still young and does not yet deeply understand the world; besides, she is in the palace and busy with duties, so she cannot attend to everything thoroughly.

units.source_text: 大凡公主，务须教养得十全十美，使人无可指摘。

en.t: A princess must always be brought up to perfection, leaving no room for anyone to criticize her.

units.source_text: 心意坚定，能够泰然度送岁月，教人不须顾虑。

en.t: She must be firm in mind and able to pass her days calmly, so that others need not worry about her.

units.source_text: 公主不比臣下：寻常百姓家的女儿，嫁个门当户对的丈夫，教养不足自有丈夫补助也。”

en.t: A princess is not like a subject; an ordinary family's daughter may marry a suitable husband, and if her education is lacking, her husband can make up for it.

units.source_text: 紫夫人答道：“我虽不会好好地教育，只要一息尚存，无不尽忠竭力。

en.t: Lady Murasaki replied, Though I may not know how to educate her well, as long as I have breath, I will devote all my loyalty and strength.

units.source_text: 但不知天命如何耳。”

en.t: Only, I do not know what heaven has decreed.

units.source_text: 她久病新愈，难免有怯弱的感觉，听见槿斋院与胧月夜尚侍如意称心、毫无阻碍地入了佛门，不胜羡慕之情。

en.t: Having only just recovered from a long illness, she inevitably felt timid and weak, and when she heard that the Asagao Princess and Oborozukiyo had entered the Buddhist path freely and without hindrance, she could not help envying them.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“尚侍所用尼僧装束，她那边的人目下尚未做惯，应由这里送去。

en.t: Genji said, The nun's garments needed by the Naishi no Kami are not yet familiar work for the people on her side, so they should be sent from here.

units.source_text: 袈裟是怎样缝制的？

en.t: How is a kesa robe sewn?

units.source_text: 请你吩咐人做吧。

en.t: Please order someone to make it.

units.source_text: 我想请东北院里的花散里夫人也做一套。

en.t: I would also like Lady Hanachirusato in the northeast quarter to make a set.

units.source_text: 过分严肃的法服，阴气沉沉，教人看了讨厌。

en.t: Religious robes that are too severe look gloomy and unpleasant to the eye.

units.source_text: 总须带点优雅之趣才好。”

en.t: They really should have a little graceful charm.

units.source_text: 紫夫人命人缝了一套深宝蓝色的尼装。

en.t: Lady Murasaki ordered someone to sew a set of deep sapphire-blue nun's garments.

units.source_text: 源氏召唤作物所的人来前，私下吩咐他动工制造尼僧应用各种器物。

en.t: Before summoning the man from the workshop, Genji privately instructed him to begin making the various articles a nun would need.

units.source_text: 茵褥、锦席、屏风、帷屏等，都十分秘密，特别加工制造。

en.t: Cushions, brocade mats, folding screens, curtain screens, and the like were all specially made with the utmost secrecy.
